source.subject: compiler: M1 front end (parse, check, JSONL diagnostics)
2B-04a: check data type declarations, names and signatures (ADR-0026)
2F-02, 2F-03 (ADR-0030), 2E-02..2E-04 (ADR-0029): effect sets with alloc and panic; escapes with rationales and trust levels

steps.prompt:
`bmb check` does not report the diagnostic E1004 yet: `#[external_body]` on a spec fn, a proof fn or `main`. It came with the commit "2F-02, 2F-03 (ADR-0030), 2E-02..2E-04 (ADR-0029): effect sets with alloc and panic; escapes with rationales and trust levels". Implement it. Examples of what `bmb check` must print (one JSON line per diagnostic; the path in `file` is the one given on the command line), each after the source line it points at:

    #[external_body]
    {"code": "E1004", "severity": "error", "message": "`#[external_body]` is for an executable function other than `main`", "file": "err/escapes.bmb", "line": 53, "col": 5, "end_line": 53, "end_col": 21, "fix": {"message": "remove the attribute", "replacement": ""}}

Everything else the program prints must stay as it is.
